#### 1. renal hypomagnesemia 5 with ocular involvement  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.411)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-420029)

**Proposed mechanism:** CLDN14 (HGNC:2505) —DISRUPTS→ Regulation of paracellular transport of ions and molecules (GO:0015160); CLDN19 (HGNC:2904) —DISRUPTS→ Regulation of paracellular transport of ions and molecules (GO:0015160); Regulation of paracellular transport of ions and molecules (GO:0015160) —DISRUPTS→ Magnesium homeostasis (CHEBI:17457); Magnesium homeostasis (CHEBI:17457) —LEADS_TO→ Hypomagnesemia (HP:0002147); Magnesium homeostasis (CHEBI:17457) —LEADS_TO→ Renal abnormalities (HP:0000077); Magnesium homeostasis (CHEBI:17457) —LEADS_TO→ Ocular abnormalities (HP:0000475). Loss-of-function mutations in CLDN14 and CLDN19 disrupt the regulation of paracellular transport in the renal tubules, leading to impaired magnesium reabsorption (hypomagnesemia), and subsequently causing renal and ocular abnormalities.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in CLDN14 or CLDN19 with a gain-of-function mechanism, or the absence of hypomagnesemia in affected individuals. _(variant: rs143734201)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of CLDN14 and CLDN19 in magnesium homeostasis and paracellular transport could lead to targeted therapies for hypomagnesemia and associated renal and ocular complications, potentially involving magnesium supplementation or modulation of tight junction protein function.
